evidence.text: This will include, among others, i) the development of a regional benchmarking dashboard with KPIs for WASH systems change monitoring, ii) support for capacity building and annual data collection and analysis of KPIs, iii) support to organize high-level events and engagement activities to review progress on the WASH acceleration agenda, including ministerial WASH summits and head of states engagement activities during AU summits, iv) support for regional civil society forums and capacity building of civil society organizations to strengthen effective dialogue on WASH at national level, and iv) technical assistance, workshops and training to develop an on-line knowledge platform, hosted by the AIP-Water Secretariat, v) the implementation of peer-learning activities for countries in the AFE region, including, South-South knowledge exchanges and multi-country learning events These knowledge exchanges will showcase best practices in areas such as PPPs utility transformation, rural water sustainability, a and urban sanitation governance.

extra_evidence.text: Subcomponent 1.1: Regional Benchmarking on Systems Change and Knowledge Platform for WASH (US$1.5 million).This subcomponent will finance activities to carry out regional benchmarking, complementing the AIP-Water Scorecard46 to monitor performance of countries in AFE region on implementing the systems change approach for WASH through a series of KPIs47 and to engage high-level decision makers at regional level to pursue the WASH systems change and acceleration agenda.
The regional benchmarking activities and the digital knowledge platform will be implemented by AUDA-NEPAD through contracting the GWP-SA48 as Secretariat for AIP-Water.

approaches.name: digital monitoring, benchmarking and verification platforms for water utilities and dams
approaches.description: Digital platforms, GIS analysis and remote dashboards collect, benchmark and verify utility, dam and groundwater data to improve performance and investment oversight. Practices: Digital benchmarking platform (NewIBNET) for utility performance; RUWASA data monitoring and visualization platform for CBWSO performance reporting; RUWASA digital monitoring platform for O&M data submission; MIS cataloging dams' safety and operational data; GIS census analysis to verify population served per water point; Geolocated timestamped photos verifying scheme investments; data monitoring and visualization platform for CBWSO performance reporting; live remote monitoring dashboard for PPP scheme verification; national groundwater information system with aquifer mapping.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: shared digital utility benchmarking platform - cue: 'digital benchmarking platform' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: This subcomponent finances: i) technical assistance to enhance the participation of utilities/service providers in countries in the AFE region in a digital benchmarking platform (NewIBNET 51 ) to improve data-driven decision making, share best practices and performance metrics, improving data integrity and reliability, and enhance skills in data management and analytics, ii) capacity development for utilities in the Eastern and Southern region through regional training programs, with a focus among others on utility turnaround, leadership development, customer and community engagement, digitalization, regulation and climate resilient service delivery, iii) technical assistance and training for the development of PIAPs for utilities in the MPA participating countries, including adequate citizen feedback mechanisms, iv) technical assistance for utilities to carry out gender equality diagnostics52 and adopt management practices to improve gender equality, and v) technical assistance for the MPA participating countries to develop strategic plans and actionable roadmaps to enhance professional management and sustainability of rural water operators, including through private sector
